author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
If we can vibe code software, what stops us from vibe code hardware? 

Imagine in the future, the local AI will automatically compile a portion of your software and run it in an embedded FPGA to makes it 1000x faster. 

Guess which company has all 3 pieces - CPU, GPU and FPGA?
